desc:
The tower that Kojimatchi is climbing!

🔥 The slime monster is coming from below! Escape the challenging 10-story tower obstacle course before it eats you!

Run, jump, and avoid obstacles—the challenge gets harder the higher you go!
Aim for the summit and earn badges on each floor. You can also challenge the fastest clear ranking!

⭐ 10-story Tower Obby
👻 Escape from Kojimatchi that is rising up
🏃 Athletic Parkour Action
🏅 Floor-specific badges and accessories
🏆 Speedrun Rankings
👥 Can be challenged with friends

Can I reach the 10th floor before Kojimatch catches me?

☆Update Information
October 15, 2026: Practice mode added! The game will now start with the R6 avatar. You can also change the player to R15.
